user.title: Set up Schluter DITRA-HEAT
user.description: Sign in with your schluterditraheat.com account, the same one the Schluter Smart Thermostat app uses. All thermostats on the account are added.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Schluter DITRA-HEAT again
reauth_confirm.description: Schluter rejected the saved password for {username}. Enter the account's current password.

reconfigure.title: Update Schluter DITRA-HEAT credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the password for this account. To connect a different Schluter account, add the integration again instead.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach schluterditraheat.com. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limit: Schluter is limiting sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.session_limit: This Schluter account has too many active sessions. Sign out of schluterditraheat.com in browsers you don't use, or stop other integrations using this account, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Schluter account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Credentials updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.wrong_account: That email belongs to a different Schluter account. To connect it, add the integration again.
